description: Puts the latest code on a live project's branch online: pulls it and restarts the app, like Pull & Restart in The Deployer. Changes a live app. Only for a project that is already live. Takes a few minutes.

project.description: The live project's id, name or repository. Optional with one project.

workspace.description: A teammate's workspace id. Default: your own.

name: redeploy
title: Redeploy a live project
